topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, there's somethin' strange 'bout seein' the world go 'round, ain't there? I was just talkin' with Eliza, she was tellin' me that Willie's got old Master Gray as his teacher now. Can you believe it? Same as me, near on twenty years back. I can't help but think of the days when I was the one sittin' in that classroom, Master Gray makin' us recite our letters and numbers till the sun sank low. I guess time moves faster than the plow, don’t it? I’m glad for Willie, but it brings back a lot of memories, some of 'em stickin’ to the tongue like old hay. Hope he’s kinder to Willie than he was to me.
